rejection_resampling_analysis: generate validates finite S bounds, I>=S+10, then whole-bank symbolic uniqueness. In normal banks all S are nonzero positive and I>S; this makes ambient/initial/sum and plus/minus equilibria distinct. Oil replacement -kT has equilibrium 0 and cannot duplicate -k(T-S) for S>0. Moderate fifth is either a distinct wrong equilibrium (I+S), nonlinear, or a nonunit/positive initial coefficient. Thus no eligible decision case is removed by the retry condition; raw oil explicitly preserves its captured duplicate WRONG pair for replay only. Explicit invalid parameters are rejected rather than resampled (packaging.json). Boundary and default sampling provide independent executable controls.
finite_domain: Task fingerprint retains ambient, unit, supplied-temperature-count; default CLI removes repeated fingerprints. Domains easy C31+F36=67 distinct tasks, moderate C31+F36=67. Initial and prose changes do not claim new core ambient tasks.
